positive_evidence: Rank 1 CYCLOPENTASILOXANE is an admitted volatile silicone carrier, rank 2 DIMETHICONOL an admitted silicone gum/conditioning film, and rank 3 ISODODECANE a hydrocarbon carrier/emollient: together they identify a carrier-supported conditioning-film architecture, rather than incidental silicone presence.
Rank 5 ARGANIA SPINOSA KERNEL OIL adds a separately admitted medium/low fixed-oil tendency to the retained system; it supports but does not independently establish medium.
counter_signal: Rank 1 CYCLOPENTASILOXANE supplies an affirmative volatile route and rank 3 ISODODECANE a hydrocarbon distribution route, so light is plausible if rank 2 DIMETHICONOL contributes a modest residual coating. Isododecane volatility is not assumed.
Rank 2 DIMETHICONOL is a gum, but a gum name alone does not prove a rich structured backbone; the vehicle/film/emollient architecture lacks a stronger affirmative rich argument.

Ranks 9 HEXAMETHYLINDANOPYRAN, 10 ACETYL CEDRENE, 11 VANILLIN and 17 FUSANUS SPICATUS WOOD OIL have unassessed functions; rank 22 LAVANDULA OIL/EXTRACT has unresolved preparation. None is treated as trace or used as positive light/rich evidence.
weight.reason: B5 medium is the stronger working interpretation because the admitted gum/conditioning-film route is functionally central to the opening vehicle/gum/carrier system. Light loses narrowly: the supplied evidence establishes a volatile delivery route but does not affirmatively reduce the conditioning gum to a secondary route. Rich loses because this is not a positively established structured gum-dominated retained system. No film amount, persistence or measured hair feel is claimed.
weight.deciding_assumption: Rank 2 DIMETHICONOL is a principal retained-conditioning route within ranks 1-3, not merely a secondary accessory to the volatile carrier. This is a qualitative architecture judgment and could reverse with formulation evidence.
unresolved: Relative carrier/gum/oil amounts and dimethiconol grade are unknown; actual modest-dose coating could favor light.
Unassessed ranks 9-11 and 17 and preparation at rank 22 remain substantive gaps, but do not currently identify an equally supported alternative first-order carrier architecture.
No comparative finished-formula hair-weight measurement; medium is low-confidence estimated load, not persistence, repair or thickness fit.

positive_evidence: Ranks 1 CYCLOPENTASILOXANE, 2 DIMETHICONE and 3 C12-15 ALKYL BENZOATE form an identifiable volatile-vehicle/conditioning-silicone/ester carrier system; rank 2 admits both carrier and conditioning-film roles, supporting the principal retained route under B5.
Rank 4 ARGANIA SPINOSA KERNEL OIL is an additional medium/low fixed-oil tendency in that system. The medium choice rests on the silicone/ester architecture, not this oil rank alone.
counter_signal: Rank 1 CYCLOPENTASILOXANE supplies a volatile route and rank 3 C12-15 ALKYL BENZOATE an ester co-carrier; light is credible if the rank 2 DIMETHICONE grade and balance yield a smaller coated feel.

Rank 10 ROSA CANINA FRUIT OIL, rank 13 ALEURITES MOLUCCANUS SEED OIL and rank 16 OENOTHERA BIENNIS (EVENING PRIMROSE) OIL have admitted light/low priors. Their later ranks neither erase their contribution nor establish the whole blend as light.

Ranks 6 HYDROLYZED KERATIN and 25 POLYQUATERNIUM-55 admit generic film-forming functions but not film thickness or load; rank 20 HYDROGENATED CASTOR OIL/SEBACIC ACID COPOLYMER admits conditioning but no film role or castor rich prior. These cannot manufacture a rich retained architecture.

Unassessed ranks 14 PSIDIUM GUAJAVA FRUIT EXTRACT, 15 ALOE BARBADENSIS LEAF JUICE, 18 GLYCOLIPIDS, 21 ARGININE HCL, 23 THIOCTIC ACID, 26 SODIUM HYALURONATE, 27 ALLANTOIN, 28 SODIUM ASCORBYL PHOSPHATE and 29 BENZOIC ACID remain unresolved, without inferred negligible load.
weight.reason: B5 medium is the affirmative intermediate carrier/film interpretation of the silicone/ester backbone. Light loses because the admitted conditioning silicone is part of that backbone, rather than demonstrably secondary to a mobile ester/volatile system. Rich loses because neither the exact protein/copolymer functions nor the number of secondary botanicals establishes a principal structured system. Missing dimethicone grade lowers robustness but leaves a working winner; medium is not a missing-data default.
weight.deciding_assumption: Rank 2 DIMETHICONE is a functionally principal retained-conditioning co-carrier with rank 3 C12-15 ALKYL BENZOATE; its unknown grade does not reverse that architecture. Generic protein and polymer functions are not assigned an additional weight score.
unresolved: Dimethicone grade, carrier balance and secondary conditioning amounts could favor light; exact generic functions do not establish deposition or finished-formula weight.
Unassessed ranks 14, 15, 18, 21, 23 and 26-29 remain gaps; rank 12 SCHINZIOPHYTON RAUTANENII KERNEL OIL has no admitted weight prior or finished-grade evidence.
Source-scoped supplier entries do not establish product grade, film mechanics, repair or persistence; no such properties classified.

positive_evidence: Rank 1 SESAMUM INDICUM SEED OIL supplies an admitted medium/low initial tendency in a coherent fixed-oil carrier base; ranks 3 PERSEA GRATISSIMA OIL and 5 ARGANIA SPINOSA KERNEL OIL support an intermediate retained-oil interpretation.

Rank 2 COCOS NUCIFERA OIL has an exact rich/low whole-oil tendency, giving an affirmative reason against light within this carrier base; rank 4 PRUNUS AMYGDALUS DULCIS OIL provides an admitted light/low counter-route.
counter_signal: Rank 2 COCOS NUCIFERA OIL is a principal rich-tendency oil, making rich the closest alternative if its contribution governs the coated feel; its early position alone does not prove that contribution outweighs the other carriers.

Rank 4 PRUNUS AMYGDALUS DULCIS OIL supports a lighter outcome, and the low-confidence sesame/avocado/argan priors allow lighter grades. Light nevertheless lacks a stronger explanation of the medium-leading base with participating whole coconut oil.

Rank 6 BRAHMI HERPESTIS (BRAHMI) FRUIT EXTRACT and rank 9 AZADIRACHTA INDICA (NEEM) OIL are not_assessed. No species correction, neem fixed-oil identity, negligible contribution or heavy floor is imported.
weight.reason: B3 supports medium for the medium-leading botanical base with a rich co-carrier and a lighter co-carrier. Rich loses narrowly: coconut supplies a real heavier hypothesis, but the declaration does not establish a rich-leading or otherwise principal structured retained system that overrides the intermediate carrier interpretation. Light is weaker because the medium leading tendency and participating whole coconut provide affirmative retained-load reasons against it. This is a qualitative whole-base judgment, not an average or oil-count majority.
weight.deciding_assumption: The opening sesame/coconut/avocado/almond/argan sequence is a coherent co-carrier base whose sesame-led intermediate tendency remains more persuasive than coconut-led richness. No amount dominance is asserted.
unresolved: Relative oil amounts, whole-coconut physical grade/temperature and actual distribution could move the result toward rich or light.
Rank 6 unresolved botanical identity/preparation and rank 9 unassessed exact neem declaration remain gaps; neither currently supplies an equally supported first-order alternative backbone.
